title_en: Regulations on Administration of Housing Provident Fund

articles.content_en: Article 1 These Regulations are formulated to strengthen the management of the housing provident fund, safeguard the legitimate rights and interests of the owners of the housing provident fund, promote urban housing construction, and improve the living standards of urban residents.

Article 2 These Regulations shall apply to the deposit, withdrawal, use, management and supervision of the housing provident fund within the territory of the People's Republic of China.
For the purposes of these Regulations, "housing provident fund" means the long-term housing savings deposited by state organs, state-owned enterprises, urban collective enterprises, enterprises with foreign investment, urban private enterprises and other urban enterprises, public institutions, private non-enterprise units, and social organizations (hereinafter collectively referred to as "units") and their on-the-job employees.
Article 3 The housing provident fund deposited by an employee individually and the housing provident fund deposited by the employee's unit for the employee shall belong to the employee individually.

Article 4 The management of the housing provident fund shall implement the principles of decision-making by the Housing Provident Fund Management Committee, operation by the Housing Provident Fund Management Center, special account storage in banks, and financial supervision.

Article 5 The housing provident fund shall be used for employees' purchase, construction, renovation, and major repair of self-occupied housing. No unit or individual may misappropriate it for other purposes.

Article 6 The deposit and lending interest rates of the housing provident fund shall be proposed by the People's Bank of China, and after soliciting the opinions of the competent administrative department of construction under the State Council, shall be submitted to the State Council for approval.

Article 7 The competent administrative department of construction under the State Council shall, together with the financial department under the State Council and the People's Bank of China, formulate policies on the housing provident fund and supervise their implementation.
The competent administrative department of construction under the people's government of a province or autonomous region shall, together with the financial department at the same level and the branches of the People's Bank of China, be responsible for supervising the implementation of the regulations and policies on housing provident fund management within its administrative region.

Article 8 Municipalities directly under the Central Government, cities where the people's governments of provinces and autonomous regions are located, and other cities divided into districts (prefectures, autonomous prefectures, and leagues) shall establish a Housing Provident Fund Management Committee as the decision-making body for housing provident fund management. Among the members of the Housing Provident Fund Management Committee, the persons in charge of the people's government and the competent departments of construction, finance, the People's Bank of China, and other relevant departments as well as relevant experts shall account for one-third, representatives of trade unions and employees shall account for one-third, and representatives of units shall account for one-third.
The director of the Housing Provident Fund Management Committee shall be a person with public credibility.

Article 10 Municipalities directly under the Central Government, cities where the people's governments of provinces and autonomous regions are located, and other cities divided into districts (prefectures, autonomous prefectures, and leagues) shall, in accordance with the principles of simplification and efficiency, establish one Housing Provident Fund Management Center to be responsible for the management and operation of the housing provident fund. Counties (cities) shall not establish Housing Provident Fund Management Centers.
The Housing Provident Fund Management Center specified in the preceding paragraph may establish branches in qualified counties (cities). The Housing Provident Fund Management Center and its branches shall implement uniform rules and regulations and conduct unified accounting.
The Housing Provident Fund Management Center is a non-profit independent public institution directly under the city people's government.

Article 12 The Housing Provident Fund Management Committee shall, in accordance with the relevant regulations of the People's Bank of China, designate a commercial bank entrusted to handle the financial business of the housing provident fund (hereinafter referred to as the "entrusted bank"); the Housing Provident Fund Management Center shall entrust the entrusted bank to handle financial businesses such as housing provident fund loans and settlements, as well as procedures for opening, depositing, and repaying housing provident fund accounts.
The Housing Provident Fund Management Center shall enter into an entrustment contract with the entrusted bank.

Article 13 The Housing Provident Fund Management Center shall establish a special account for the housing provident fund in the entrusted bank.
A unit shall register for the deposit of the housing provident fund with the Housing Provident Fund Management Center and go through the procedures for opening housing provident fund accounts for its employees. Each employee may have only one housing provident fund account.
The Housing Provident Fund Management Center shall establish a subsidiary ledger of employees' housing provident fund to record the deposit, withdrawal, and other circumstances of each employee's housing provident fund.

Article 14 A newly established unit shall, within 30 days from its establishment, register for the deposit of the housing provident fund with the Housing Provident Fund Management Center, and within 20 days from the date of registration, go through the procedures for opening housing provident fund accounts for its employees.
Where a unit is merged, split, dissolved, or bankrupt, the original unit or the liquidation organization shall, within 30 days from the occurrence of the aforesaid circumstances, go through the procedures for modification or cancellation of registration with the Housing Provident Fund Management Center, and within 20 days from the completion of the modification or cancellation of registration, go through the procedures for transfer or sealing up of the employees' housing provident fund accounts.

Article 15 Where a unit employs a worker, it shall, within 30 days from the date of employment, register for deposit with the Housing Provident Fund Management Center and go through the procedures for opening or transferring the employee's housing provident fund account.
Where a unit terminates the labor relationship with an employee, the unit shall, within 30 days from the date of termination of the labor relationship, go through the procedures for modification of registration with the Housing Provident Fund Management Center and go through the procedures for transfer or sealing up of the employee's housing provident fund account.

Article 16 The monthly deposit amount of an employee's housing provident fund shall be the employee's average monthly salary of the previous year multiplied by the employee's housing provident fund deposit ratio.
The monthly deposit amount of the housing provident fund deposited by the unit for the employee shall be the employee's average monthly salary of the previous year multiplied by the unit's housing provident fund deposit ratio.

Article 17 A newly employed worker shall start depositing the housing provident fund from the second month of employment, and the monthly deposit amount shall be the employee's salary of that month multiplied by the employee's housing provident fund deposit ratio.
An employee newly transferred into a unit shall start depositing the housing provident fund from the date the transferring unit pays wages, and the monthly deposit amount shall be the employee's salary of that month multiplied by the employee's housing provident fund deposit ratio.

Article 18 The deposit ratios of both the employee and the unit for the housing provident fund shall not be lower than 5% of the employee's average monthly salary of the previous year; cities with the necessary conditions may appropriately increase the deposit ratio. The specific deposit ratio shall be drafted by the Housing Provident Fund Management Committee, reviewed by the people's government at the same level, and submitted to the people's government of the province, autonomous region, or municipality directly under the Central Government for approval.

Article 19 The housing provident fund deposited by an employee individually shall be deducted and paid by the unit from the employee's wages each month.
The unit shall, within 5 days from the date of paying the employees' wages each month, remit the housing provident fund deposited by the unit and deducted on behalf of the employees into the special housing provident fund account, and the entrusted bank shall record it into the employees' housing provident fund accounts.

Article 20 A unit shall deposit the housing provident fund in full and on time, and shall not delay or under-deposit.
For a unit that truly has difficulties in depositing the housing provident fund, after discussion and approval by the employees' congress or trade union of the unit, and after examination by the Housing Provident Fund Management Center and approval by the Housing Provident Fund Management Committee, it may reduce the deposit ratio or defer the deposit; it shall increase the deposit ratio or make up the deferred deposit when its economic benefits improve.
Article 21 The housing provident fund shall accrue interest at the interest rate prescribed by the State from the date it is deposited into the employee's housing provident fund account.
Article 22 The Housing Provident Fund Management Center shall issue valid certificates of housing provident fund deposit to employees who deposit the housing provident fund.

Article 25 Where an employee withdraws the balance stored in his or her housing provident fund account, the unit to which the employee belongs shall verify the matter and issue a withdrawal certificate.
The employee shall apply to the Housing Provident Fund Management Center for withdrawal of the housing provident fund by presenting the withdrawal certificate. The Housing Provident Fund Management Center shall, within 3 days from the date of receiving the application, make a decision on whether to approve the withdrawal and notify the applicant; if the withdrawal is approved, the entrusted bank shall handle the payment procedures.

Article 26 An employee who deposits the housing provident fund may apply to the Housing Provident Fund Management Center for a housing provident fund loan when purchasing, constructing, renovating, or carrying out major repair of self-occupied housing.
The Housing Provident Fund Management Center shall, within 15 days from the date of receiving the application, make a decision on whether to approve the loan and notify the applicant; if the loan is approved, the entrusted bank shall handle the loan procedures.
The risks of housing provident fund loans shall be borne by the Housing Provident Fund Management Center.
Article 27 An applicant who applies for a housing provident fund loan shall provide security.

Article 28 The Housing Provident Fund Management Center may, on the premise of ensuring the withdrawal and loan of the housing provident fund and with the approval of the Housing Provident Fund Management Committee, use the housing provident fund to purchase government bonds.
The Housing Provident Fund Management Center shall not provide security to others.

Article 29 The value-added income from the housing provident fund shall be deposited into a special account for the value-added income of the housing provident fund opened by the Housing Provident Fund Management Center in the entrusted bank, and shall be used for establishing a risk reserve for housing provident fund loans, the management expenses of the Housing Provident Fund Management Center, and supplementary funds for the construction of urban low-rent housing.

Article 30 The management expenses of the Housing Provident Fund Management Center shall be compiled by the Housing Provident Fund Management Center as the total annual budget expenditure according to the prescribed standards, and after being approved by the financial department of the people's government at the same level, shall be turned over from the value-added income of the housing provident fund to the finance at the same level, which shall allocate the funds.
The standards for management expenses of the Housing Provident Fund Management Center shall be formulated by the competent administrative department of construction of the people's government of the province, autonomous region, or municipality directly under the Central Government together with the financial department at the same level at a level slightly higher than the cost standards for public institutions prescribed by the State.

Article 31 The financial department of the relevant local people's government shall strengthen supervision over the collection, withdrawal, and use of the housing provident fund within its administrative region, and shall report to the Housing Provident Fund Management Committee of the people's government at the same level.
When the Housing Provident Fund Management Center formulates the plan for collection and use of the housing provident fund, it shall seek the opinions of the financial department.
When the Housing Provident Fund Management Committee examines and approves the plan for collection and use of the housing provident fund and the report on its implementation, the financial department shall participate.

Article 32 The annual budget and final accounts of the housing provident fund compiled by the Housing Provident Fund Management Center shall, after being examined by the financial department, be submitted to the Housing Provident Fund Management Committee for deliberation.
The Housing Provident Fund Management Center shall periodically submit financial reports to the financial department and the Housing Provident Fund Management Committee each year, and shall publish the financial reports to the public.
Article 33 The Housing Provident Fund Management Center shall accept the audit supervision of the audit department according to law.

Article 35 The Housing Provident Fund Management Center shall urge the entrusted bank to handle the business agreed in the entrustment contract in a timely manner.
The entrusted bank shall, in accordance with the entrustment contract, periodically provide the relevant business materials to the Housing Provident Fund Management Center.

Article 36 Employees and units shall have the right to inquire about the deposit and withdrawal of their own or their unit's housing provident fund. The Housing Provident Fund Management Center and the entrusted bank shall not refuse such inquiries.
Where employees or units have objections to the balance stored in the housing provident fund account, they may apply to the entrusted bank for a review; if they have objections to the review result, they may apply to the Housing Provident Fund Management Center for a re-review. The entrusted bank and the Housing Provident Fund Management Center shall give a written reply within 5 days from the date of receiving the application.
Employees shall have the right to expose, report, and accuse any acts of misappropriation of the housing provident fund.

Article 37 Where a unit violates the provisions of these Regulations by failing to register for the deposit of the housing provident fund or to go through the procedures for opening housing provident fund accounts for its employees, the Housing Provident Fund Management Center shall order it to do so within a specified time limit; if it fails to do so within the time limit, it shall be fined not less than RMB 10,000 but not more than RMB 50,000.

Article 38 Where a unit violates the provisions of these Regulations by failing to deposit or under-depositing the housing provident fund within the prescribed time limit, the Housing Provident Fund Management Center shall order it to make the deposit within a specified time limit; if it still fails to make the deposit within the time limit, the Housing Provident Fund Management Center may apply to the People's Court for compulsory execution.

Article 39 Where the Housing Provident Fund Management Committee violates the provisions of these Regulations in examining and approving the use plan of the housing provident fund, the competent administrative department of construction under the State Council together with the financial department under the State Council, or the competent administrative department of construction of the people's government of the province or autonomous region together with the financial department at the same level, shall, in accordance with their administrative functions and powers, order it to make corrections within a specified time limit.

Article 41 Where anyone violates the provisions of these Regulations by misappropriating the housing provident fund, the competent administrative department of construction under the State Council or the competent administrative department of construction of the people's government of the province or autonomous region shall, in accordance with its administrative functions and powers, recover the misappropriated housing provident fund and confiscate the illegal gains; the persons in charge of the people's government and the persons in charge of the relevant government departments who misappropriate or approve the misappropriation of the housing provident fund, as well as the persons in charge and other directly responsible persons of the Housing Provident Fund Management Center who are liable, shall be investigated for criminal liability in accordance with the provisions of the Criminal Law on the crime of misappropriation of public funds or other crimes; if the act does not constitute a criminal offense, they shall be given administrative sanctions of demotion or dismissal.
Article 42 Where the Housing Provident Fund Management Center violates financial regulations, the financial department shall impose an administrative penalty according to law.

Article 43 Where the Housing Provident Fund Management Center violates the provisions of these Regulations by providing security to others, the directly responsible persons in charge and other directly responsible persons shall be given administrative sanctions according to law.

Article 44 Where a state organ functionary abuses his or her powers, neglects his or her duties, or engages in malpractice for personal gain in the supervision and management of the housing provident fund, which constitutes a crime, criminal liability shall be investigated according to law; if the act does not constitute a crime, an administrative sanction shall be given according to law.

Article 45 The measures for financial management and accounting of the housing provident fund shall be formulated by the financial department under the State Council in consultation with the competent administrative department of construction under the State Council.

Article 46 Units that have not yet registered for the deposit of the housing provident fund and gone through the procedures for opening housing provident fund accounts for their employees before the coming into force of these Regulations shall, within 60 days from the date these Regulations come into force, register for deposit with the Housing Provident Fund Management Center and go through the procedures for opening housing provident fund accounts for their employees at the entrusted bank.
Article 47 These Regulations shall come into force as of the date of promulgation.
